t3_articulation_points.notes: n searches as one bitset loop (bit v = search in G-v from v's min neighbour, R_u starts {u}); rounds over unscoped-lambda channels, 3 rounds in flight; cut set = OR_u(Nb_u & ~R_u). Keyed-emission version was 1586.

t3_budget_reach.notes: Reused the exp7 fair-baseline Bend unchanged (frontier Bellman-Ford over tuple tries, budget as acceptance bound, 1-round lookahead). A channel version was mixed (1477 seed 0, 1975 seed 1), so not adopted. Walk-bound on large m (b=0 cases = pure walk).

t3_cheapest_k_walk.notes: k fixed-count ungated (min,+) rounds over directed channels (no convergence test, rounds pipeline). Keyed-emission version: 2237 depth / 848k itrs; channels: same depth, half the work. Depth grows with k (seed 2 median 4004).

t3_closure_size.notes: All-sources BFS as one bitset frontier loop over directed channels (3 rounds in flight); keyed-emission version 4268 -> channels 1886. Worst case = long chains (rounds ~ diameter).

t3_cycle_rank.notes: m - n + c; c by min-label propagation over channels (unscoped-lambda wires per edge, Braun tree per vertex), 3 rounds in flight. exp7-engine version 3841 -> 2038.

t3_girth.notes: Bitset all-sources BFS with a saturating two-counter per bit; odd (2k+1) / even (2k+2) detection; channels, 3 rounds in flight. Keyed version 2392 -> 1484 (2x the work).

t3_kcore_size.notes: Synchronous peeling over channels (alive bits), 3 rounds in flight. Keyed-emission version 2163 -> 1859 (seed 1 equal).

t3_minimax_path.notes: Frontier Bellman-Ford with the (min,max) semiring over channels, 3 rounds in flight. Keyed exp7-engine version 2269 -> 1697.

t3_mst_second.notes: Prim in n fixed steps. Leaf v holds (key, parent, in-tree, row W[v]). A step: the winner's row is zipped down, leaves relax, the min key is reduced up, then the winner's row+index are taken bottom-up by switches on 'left min == global min' (all fire in parallel; other rows go back to their leaves via unscoped-lambda closers). Then ancestor rows by dataflow (sink at parent), a second edge pass fetches rows by return addresses, maxpath = min_a max(R_u[a], R_v[a]). Versions: take-by-descent 29.4k -> argmin-and-take in one switch-reduce 22.3k -> arithmetic reduce + parallel-switch take 17.1k -> min-only reduce 16.1k. Inherently n sequential steps (~125 rounds each); a per-leaf arithmetic row select gave 20.8k at 50M itrs (rejected). Boruvka (log n phases) not attempted.

t3_sources_sinks.notes: Reused the exp7 fair-baseline Bend unchanged: at the Bend list-walk floor (~9 rounds/edge); nothing left to gain in Bend.

t3_topo_order.notes: n fixed steps (lexicographic Kahn is sequential; batching simulated in Python: still ~n steps). Leaf keeps in-degree + in-neighbour bitset (16-bit word tree); the winner a is broadcast down with a one-hot word mask, leaves AND/OR it locally (done/available leaves skip), and the next argmin is reduced up in the same traversal. Versions: take rows 22.1k -> 4-ary 19.8k -> bitset leaves 14.5k -> arithmetic select 10.4k -> mask broadcast 9.2k, at ~2x the frozen work.

t3_triangle_count.notes: Reused the exp7 fair-baseline Bend unchanged (bitset rows by keyed setb, rows fetched per edge by unscoped-lambda return addresses, popcount AND). Walk-bound.

t5_cluster_histogram.notes: Min-label components over channels (3 in flight), scatter-count by label (keyed adds), one-hot 8-vector reduce. exp7-engine version 2119 -> 1454.

t5_cluster_same.notes: Min-label components over channels; query list walked in parallel pushing return-address sinks; labels wired to sinks. exp7-engine version 1692 -> 1477.

t5_decide_count.notes: Plain accumulator walk with branch-free add; at the list-walk floor (the frozen 2-cells-per-call unrolling was slower).

t5_decide_singleton.notes: One pass, branch-free running max (+1 offset so ties keep the lowest index).

t5_prop_majority.notes: Two walks in parallel (membership bits from c, wanted-key values from attrs, keyed sets), leafwise zip collects the cluster's values, O(s^2) mode on the short list. Bound by the attrs walk (~9 rounds/triple).

t5_rewrite_collapsed.notes: c -> position-keyed tree; edge walk in parallel pushes return-address sinks; per-x sorted dedup lists; m - total. A pair-bitset version had equal depth (2129) but 2.4x the work.

t5_rewrite_degrees.notes: As collapsed, but a symmetric pair bitset (rows keyed by x), popcount per canonical id (fixed points), tail-threaded output.

t5_rewrite_sameas_cycle.notes: Pointer doubling with path minima (M(i) = min of p^1..p^(2^j)(i)); gather by handing the table down the index tree; M(i) == i for a non-root => cycle; all targets roots => none; early exit. Fixed-l-rounds version 3096 depth / 3.1M itrs -> 2037 / 0.95M.

t5_rewrite_sameas_roots.notes: Pure dataflow: each node pushes a return-address sink at its parent's leaf (Braun tree) and outputs i or the arriving root; no rounds. Bound by the length walk + main walk.

t5_rewrite_weighted.notes: c tree + edge walk with return-address sinks; (y, w) routed to leaf x = min(c[u], c[v]); y-sorted merge-insert lists per leaf; tail-threaded output.
